---
title: "Crop Pollination"
---

This site presents the **crop pollination ecosystem service accounts** of the European Union for 2000, 2006, 2012, 2018
and 2024. Crop pollination is the fertilisation of crops by wild insects, which maintains or increases crop production.
The accounts map where the environment can support wild pollinators, where crops depend on them, how much production can
be attributed to the service and how much demand remains unmet, in physical and monetary terms.

The [report](documentation/methods/crop-pollination/index.qmd) describes the methods, the decisions taken along the way
and the results. The [Downloads](downloads/index.qmd) page holds the tables by NUTS region and the 100 m maps. The
numbered scripts in the folder <https://github.com/renatovargas/jrc-pollination/tree/main/scripts> reproduce the work, and
Annex I of the report explains each of them.
